text: Tasha: quick sync noticed a few UX and a11y things in the Alerting > Thresholds frame. Two high-level asks: 1) unit control (inline dropdown vs compact toggle) and how to expose verbose text for screen readers; 2) preview area: muted channels overlap the rule title at narrow widths, and fallbacks are invisible. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/thresholds-overlap-variant.png Milo: inline dropdown feels safest for discoverability. But can we visually render `5m` and expose `per 5 minutes` via aria-describedby? That keeps layout tight but explicit to ATs. Renee: Copy nits: helper currently says `when occurrences > 10`. Suggest `when occurrences exceed 10 within 10 minutes` or `within the selected window` + tooltip linking to docs. Also change preview label to `Previewing 3 channels 1 muted` instead of `Preview (3)`. Vik: Mobile pattern: ditch horizontal pill scroller. Show first pill row then a "+N more" button that expands a stacked list. When expanded, give it role=dialog? maybe role=list with aria-roledescription='channels'. Avoid complex modals. accessibility-bot: Contrast report: muted-pill text #777777 on #FFFFFF = 3.6. AA 14px needs 4.5. Recommend neutral-800 (#2E2E2E) or semibold 600 at 14px. Also suggest focus-visible ring for pills (2px solid token-focus). Milo: Edge case: routing fallbacks are hidden. Preview should show `Primary: Slack (latency) — Fallback: Email (on error)` with subtle divider and tooltip that explains fallback triggers and latency tiers. That helps SREs confirm behavior. Renee: A11y behavior: when a user toggles suppression, announce via aria-live polite: `Suppression enabled 2 channels muted`. Keep muted channels in DOM but dim them (aria-pressed/state). Also ensure keyboard order: threshold value -> units control -> suppression toggle -> preview expand -> save. Tasha: Implementation idea: render `5m` label but include per 5 minutes (or aria-describedby reference). Also show resolved template values in preview if rule uses variables (example vs raw toggle). Vik: For contrast token, I'll pick neutral-800 and update the design tokens file. For mobile, I'll mock the "+N more" expansion with aria-expanded on the button and aria-controls linking to the list id. Milo: I'll produce two mocks by tomorrow: micro-dropdown and toggle+sr-only verbose. I'll include keyboard interaction notes and aria attributes. Renee: I'll update microcopy and add the helper tooltip content. Also will add the text for aria-live announcements. Tasha: action items recap: Milo -> mocks; Vik -> design tokens + mobile mock; Renee -> copy & aria-live text; accessibility-bot -> contrast token confirm. Target: next design huddle Friday. Thanks team :raised_hands:
